slides.title: Meet Bolt
slides.text: Bolt is a robot. Bolt does exactly what the blocks say, one step at a time, in order.

slides.title: Steps in order
slides.text: A list of steps in order is called an algorithm. If two steps swap places, Bolt ends up somewhere else.
slides.say: A list of steps in order is called an algorithm. If two steps swap places, Bolt ends up somewhere else.

slides.title: Try it in your head
slides.text: The flag is three squares ahead. This program gets Bolt there.

slides.title: Turning is not moving
slides.text: The block turn left spins Bolt in place. Only move takes Bolt to a new square.

slides.title: Words to know
slides.text: Use these words in the game.

words.means: a list of steps in order

slides.title: Your mission
slides.text: Help Bolt reach the flag on each level. When two routes work, pick the one with fewer steps.
